fields.label: 1.7. Is the settlement officially notified by the government?
fields.description:
Notified: an informal settlement or residential area officially identified, declared and recognized by the Government of Telangana or the Municipal Corporation (GHMC) under relevant laws and notifications; formally recorded and generally eligible for government-supported infrastructure, basic services and welfare.

Non-Notified: a low-income informal settlement (basti) that developed without formal planning and has not been officially recognized or declared by the Government of Telangana or GHMC; typically inadequate housing, limited basic services and insecure tenure, not in official records.

Resettlement: households covered under a government housing scheme and residing in government-constructed housing settlements.

fields.label: 1.8. Is the settlement located on government or private land?
fields.description:
Government: the household occupies and resides on government land.
Private: the household occupies and resides on private land, with or without the landlord's permission.

fields.label: 1.9. Category of settlement
fields.options:
A: Settled settlements with Land Tenure
B: Settled settlements without Land Tenure
C: Resettlement Areas
D: Emerging settlements
fields.description:
Category A: households in permanent or semi-permanent structures (pucca, semi-pucca or tin-roof) with valid land ownership or occupancy rights (patta, title deed or government authorization) and access to electricity, drinking water and sanitation.

Category B: households in permanent or semi-permanent structures without formal land ownership or legal occupancy rights; may be on encroached government land, private land, or sites without approved municipal permissions or regularized tenure.

Category C: households covered under a government housing scheme, in government-constructed colonies or rehabilitation settlements with access to basic infrastructure and amenities.

Category D: informal settlements that emerged in the last 0-5 years, mainly in peripheral or newly developing areas, often set up by recent migrant families with limited access to basic services.

fields.label: 1.10. Is this settlement located close to any of these locations?
fields.options:
A: Along nala
B: Along railway track
C: Industrial area
Other (specify)
fields.description:
A - beside a nala/drain or stormwater channel.
B - adjacent to or close to railway tracks or railway land.
C - within or near industrial estates, factories, warehouses or manufacturing units.
Other - in a residential, commercial, roadside, peri-urban or any other area not covered above.
